versions.content: The job of the function NvM_ReadAll shall set the block specific request result to NVM_REQ_NOT_OK if: - the MemIf reports MEMIF_JOB_FAILED and - NvMRomBlockDataAddress is not configured (no ROM block with default data is available) for the block and - NvMInitBlockCallback is not configured (no init callback) for the block.
